review_scope: Independent narrow review of the serial Z then X then DM transaction and the X-near-zero correction; no hardware actions.
findings: Closed prior finding: during EMPTY_HANDOFF, the STOP check precedes use of the existing 0.2-degree X near-goal threshold. If no movement frame is needed, ordinary polling still checks the actual X position and zero speed before marking X DONE.
Initially only Z prepares and starts. Real Z DONE enables X prepare; both real X and Z DONE enable DM prepare. The EMPTY transaction cannot enter queued two-axis broadcast.

The original transaction owner, timeout, STOP/ACK, and definite drive rejection remain. Only two source files changed; the preset, PC13, placement PWM dwell, 40mm target, 2mm/1deg alignment, and final zero remain unchanged.
